title: Options and lashing eyes
summary: Reviews discuss the car as an alternative choice, the lack of a manual gearbox, and unclear availability of luggage-net and lashing-eye cargo options.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the car as a good option for new BMW buyers or as an appealing alternative to common SUVs, with one also wishing for a manual without changing the positive overall view.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on the absence of a manual gearbox as a reason for a lower rating.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention unclear or missing availability of lashing eyes, luggage-net related fittings, and other options without enough context to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic mixes broad vehicle-choice comments with specific cargo-lashing and equipment-option details rather than one single coherent issue.
Several examples are informational or incomplete, so the sentiment and exact customer stance cannot always be determined from the fragments alone.
The sample is small and stratified, so it does not show how common these option or lashing-eye issues are beyond the provided reviews.
